programme.title: Seo BBC ALBA. This is BBC ALBA
programme.desc: Sealladh ùr bho Alba. A new view from Scotland.

programme.title: Lon le Linda
programme.desc: An-diugh tha Pàdraig agus Heidi còmhla rithe ‘s iad a’ dèanamh coiridh ghlasrach. Ach mus tòisich iad, feumaidh iad a bhith cinnteach gu bheil an stuth a tha a dhìth orra a-staigh. Mur a bheil, bidh iad a’ dèanamh liosta agus a’ dol dhan bhùth airson a h-uile càil fhaighinn. Bidh Linda agus a caraidean cuideachd a’ faighinn a-mach mar a thathar a’ fàs càl-colaig. Tha iad an uairsin a’ tilleadh dhan chidsin airson a’ choiridh ullachadh mus suidh iad sìos aig a’ bhòrd ga ithe. Linda is joined by Patrick and Heidi to make vegetable curry. Before cooking, they have to ensure all the ingredients are present. If not, they make a list and go shopping for what's missing. They also learn more about how cauliflowers are grown, then return to the kitchen to make the curry before sitting down to tuck in.

programme.title: Oscar & Ealasaid
programme.desc: Tha Oscar tinn agus tha Ealasaid a’ coimhead às a dhèidh. Ge-tà, tha Oscar ga ghiùlain fhèin mar leanabh beag agus e ag iarraidh a chead fhèin fad na h-ùine. Ernest is sick, and Célestine is taking care of him. But Ernest is acting like a child and wants to do things his own way!

programme.title: Cleasan Ataidh & Tilidh/The Adventures of Abney & Teal
programme.desc: Tha stoirm le dealanaich is tàirneanaich a’ toirt luchd-tadhail chun an eilein. Tha Àtaidh is Tilidh air leth measail air na caraidean ùra aca, ach chan eil Nìp ro chinnteach. A thunderstorm brings some visitors to the island. Abney and Teal love their new friends, but Neep is not so sure.

programme.title: Abadas
programme.desc: Tha Ben agus na h-Abadas a' cluich an geama fhaclan 's Ben ag iarraidh orra bara-cuibhle a lorg. Tha Hari, Seren 's Ella uile den bheachd gun tig aca air am facal ùr a lorg ach cò thig a thaghadh an-diugh? Ben plays the word game with the Abadas and sends them on a search for a wheelbarrow. Hari, Seren and Ela all believe they can find out the meaning of the word, but who will go on the adventure?

programme.title: An Teaghlach Rìoghail an Ath-dhoras/The Royals Next Door
programme.desc: Tha aig a' chlann ri diofar pheataichean a thoirt leotha dhan sgoil an-diugh oir ‘s e Là Bi-iomadachd a th’ann. Tha Stella feumach air taic – saoil an tèid Mgr P ann còmhla rithe? The children have to take different pets to school as it’s Biodiversity Day. Stella needs help, but will Mgr P go with her?

programme.title: An Teaghlach Rìoghail an Ath-dhoras/The Royals Next Door
programme.desc: Tha an dealbh Rìoghail dol a bhith air a thogail a-nochd ach, gu mì-fhortanach, tha cùisean air a dhol ceàrr le Stella. Tha trioblaid dathadh-fuilt ag adhbharachadh gu bheil falt Stella air a mhilleadh. Dè chanas an Rìgh 's a' Bhànrigh? The Royal portrait is being taken tonight but, unfortunately, things have gone awry for Stella. A dye incident has meant that her hair is ruined. What will the King and Queen say?

programme.title: Uaine
programme.desc: Tha pailteas de stòras nàdarra an Alba agus tha Calum a’ tadhal air trì pròiseactan eadar-dhealaichte airson sùil a ghabhail air an seòrsa cumhachd a dh’fhaodadh sinn a bhith a’ cruthachadh san àm ri teachd. Scotland is a country full of untapped natural resources and Calum visits three different projects to find out about the kind of energy we could be producing in the future.

programme.title: Clann Na Cruinne
programme.desc: Tha Hanka aona bhliadhna-deug, à Slobhagia, ‘s bidh i a' dol don aon sgoil san t-saoghal a tha a’ teagasg seabhagaireachd mar phàirt den churraicealam àbhaisteach. Hanka is 11, from Slovakia, and she attends the only school in the world where falconry is taught as part of the regular curriculum.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Fonn mo Bheatha
programme.desc: Music and chat programme presented by Cathy Ann MacPhee with guest Iain Mackay. Archive Ceòl agus còmhradh le Cathy Ann Nic a Phi còmhla ri Iain Mac|Aoidh. Producer:- Magaidh NicFhionghuin In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Somhairle Spins
programme.desc: Tha Somhairle agus athair a’ cur an dàimh a th’aca gu deuchainn air Ìle agus Diùra, le aon teanta bheag, dà stòbha campachaidh agus aon bhaidhsagal airson dithis! Somhairle and his dad test the limits of their relationship on Islay and Jura - equipped with one small tent, two camping stoves and a bicycle made for two!

programme.title: Rudan Beaga Bòidheach/Life’s Little Things
programme.desc: Tha Niamh dèidheil air a bhith a’ ruith agus tha eacarsaich na pàirt chudromach dha a beatha. Niamh loves running and being active is a big part of her life.

programme.title: Binneas - Na Trads
programme.desc: Na Peatbog Faeries a’ toirt Duaisean nan Trads 2023 gu crìch le seata goirid. A’ gabhail a-steach The Jesster, Ann Robertson’s Kitchen agus Innes Drinks the Bru. Peatbog Faeries bring the Trad Awards 2023 to a close with this short concert set. The featured tracks include The Jesster, Ann Robertson’s Kitchen and Innes Drinks the Bru.

programme.title: Slighe Naoimh Cuithbeirt/St Cuthbert's Way
programme.desc: Iagan MacNèill a’leantail Slighe Naoimh Chuithbeirt a St Boswells gu Lilliardsedge. Iagan MacNeil explores the St Cuthbert’s Way, from St Boswells to Lilliardsedge.

programme.title: Garradh Phadruig
programme.desc: Peter is busy planting in the garden and helps two budding gardeners with a pumpkin. Tha Pàdruig trang a’cur sa ghàrradh, agus a’cuideachadh dithis òga a’cur pheapaig.

programme.title: Sona
programme.desc: Tha Vicky Kilgour, le cuid meas air sauna, a’ gabhail a’ rathaid air costa an iar na h-Alba agus i a’ sireadh sunnd is toileachas, le a caraid Donnchadh Dòmhnallach na cuideachd. Bidh dreach air leth saorsnail air an eapasod seo, agus an dithis aca a’ feuchainn a-mach beagan yòga agus a’ gabhail tlachd ann an seisean dian de shearapaidh-fuaim. Às a sin, togaidh iad orra gu uaigneas draoidheil Chnòideart, agus Tuathanas Coimhearsnachd na sgìre, far an cuir iad an sgilean gu feum ann am gàrradh-margaidh. Sauna lover Vicky Kilgour embarks on a road trip up Scotland’s west coast in search of well-being and happiness, with friend Duncan MacDonald along for the ride. The pair try out some yoga and enjoy an intensive sound therapy session, before heading off to the magically remote world of Knoydart Community Farm where they dabble in some market gardening. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Cuirm aig Celtic
programme.desc: Cuirm shònraichte bho Sian aig Celtic Connections gus an dàrna clàr aca a chomharrachadh. Anns a’ buidheann Ghàidhlig Albannach, tha triùir dhen na seinneadairean Gàidhlig as fheàrr – Eilidh NicCarmaig, Ceitlin Lilidh & Ellen NicDhòmhnaill – le luchd-ciùil eile nan cois gus an clàr aca a thaisbeanadh beò ann an dòigh nach cualas roimhe. Le taic bho Bon Débarras. Air a chlàradh aig Talla Barony. Sian perform an exclusive concert at Celtic Connections to celebrate the release of their second album. The Scottish Gaelic folk group comprises three of today’s top Gaelic singers – Eilidh Cormack, Ceitlin Lilidh and Ellen MacDonald – who are joined by an extended line-up of musicians to perform the album live as never before. Support comes from Bon Débarras. Recorded at The Barony Hall. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Skerryvore Aig Caisteal Floors
programme.desc: Cuirm shònraichte a’ comharrachadh 20 bliadhna de Skerryvore ann an àrainn àlainn Caisteal Floors, Cealsaidh, sna Crìochan. Tha an còmhlan ainmeil Albannach air a bhith am meadhan saoghal ceòl na h-Alba airson dà dheichead. A bharrachd air aoighean sònraichte, còmhlain is caraidean, bidh nam mìltean de luchd-leantainn aig a’ chuirm as motha aca riamh. Air a lìbhrigeadh le Megan NicGill-Fhaolain. A special concert recorded at Floors Castle to celebrate 20 years of Skerryvore. The legendary Scottish band have been at the forefront of Scotland’s music scene for two decades and are joined by special guests, bands and friends, as well as thousands of fans, for their biggest ever show. Presented by Megan MacLellan. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: An Cruinne Caochlaideach/Dynamic Planet
programme.desc: As Earth’s climate changes, the once-stable natural systems that we rely upon are being thrown into chaos.

programme.title: Belladrum
programme.desc: Tha Fiona NicChoinnich agus Niall Iain Dòmhnallach a’ cur fàilt’ air Skipinnish gu Àrd-Ùrlar Hot House. Freumhaichte ann an ceòl bho thaobh siar na h-Alba, chomharraich an còmhlan 25 bliadhna còmhla le cuirm shònraichte aig Caisteal Dhùn Èidinn an-uiridh agus le taisbeanadh sgoinneil eile an seo, bha an luchd-leantainn a’ seinn ’s a’ dannsa a-rithist air latha 2 de Belladrum 2025. Fiona MacKenzie and Niall Iain Macdonald welcome Skipinnish to the Hot House Stage. Rooted in Scotland’s west coast music scene, the band celebrated 25 years with a spectacular show at Edinburgh Castle last year. Another rousing performance had their fans singing and dancing all over again on day two of Belladrum.

programme.title: Horizon
programme.desc: The oceans define the earth. They are crucial to life and we used to think that they were unique to our blue planet. But we were wrong. It has recently been discovered that there are oceans all over our solar system, and they are very similar to our own. And now scientists are going on an epic journey in search of new life in places that never seemed possible. Nasa is even planning to dive to the depths of a strange, distant ocean in a remarkable submarine. Horizon discovers that the hunt for oceans in space is marking the dawn of a new era in the search for alien life.

programme.title: Life on Earth
programme.desc: David Attenborough looks at the role of a few of the millions of insect species, some of which have developed extremely close relationships with plants. Insects pollinate flowers and in some cases neither flower nor insect can survive without the other.

programme.title: The Sentinels
programme.desc: In 1915, soldier Gabriel Ferraud is badly injured on the front lines. He is then selected to join a top-secret army research project: the Sentinels program. With this research comes Dyxenal, a serum that creates a whole new breed of soldier. In French and German with English subtitles. 1915, France - after sustaining severe injuries on the WWI battle field, soldier Gabriel Ferraud is unwittingly selected to join a top-secret army research project aimed at creating a whole new breed of soldier: the Sentinels. In French with English subtitles.

programme.title: The Sentinels
programme.desc: Gabriel must join the Sentinels brigade if he ever wants to be reunited with his family, who believe him dead. An attack on the secret military laboratory prompts an investigation, much to the displeasure of Colonel Mirreau, who heads the Sentinels program. In French and German with English subtitles.

programme.title: The Black Forest Murders
programme.desc: When DCI Barbara Kramer and her colleague Thomas Riedle get the message that a young woman from Buchingen has not returned home from a run, the local force and concerned villagers have already been searching for her for 17 hours. They face an uphill struggle to prevent evidence from being destroyed, a contingency which becomes more salient when a body is discovered 72 hours later. In German with English subtitles.

programme.title: The Black Forest Murders
programme.desc: Despite the team working many hours of overtime on the Berghoff case, there are still few leads to follow. The forensic team is able to isolate the DNA of an unknown male, but the databases do not provide a match. The discovery of a second body less than 20 miles away leads the team to believe a serial killer is at work. In German with English subtitles

programme.desc: Adrienne Murray has rare access to Microsoft's Quantum Lab in Denmark, Ammie Sekhon checks out the action and innovation at this year's Red Bull Soapbox Race, Melissa Hogenboom visits the UK's first Longevity Show to explore the boom in personalised nutrients, and Andrew Rogers visits the UK aerospace company developing a nuclear fusion-powered rocket.

programme.title: China's Greatest Treasures
programme.desc: Dragon is the ultimate symbol of China. Chinese people often call themselves the descendants of the dragon. Unlike in western mythology where dragons are depicted as monsters to be tamed, in China, dragons are seen as life-giving, beneficent and auspicious. Once you know about them, you notice them everywhere in China. In this episode, Alastair explores the art of dragons, to understand how this mythical creature has become so ingrained in Chinese national identity.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: The latest news from the BBC.

programme.title: What Happened at...?
programme.desc: On 1 July 1916, nearly 20,000 British soldiers were killed on the first day of the Battle of the Somme – one of the bloodiest days in the history of warfare and a lasting symbol of both sacrifice and futility. In this documentary, Jordan Dunbar examines how communities have been shaped by the battle and reveals how its legacy continues to resonate through families - including his own.

programme.title: The Media Show
programme.desc: Nigel Farage has accused parts of the British media of mounting a politically-motivated campaign against him after reports about his financial interests prompted an investigation by Parliament's Standards Commissioner. Gabriel Pogrund, editor of the Insight investigations team at The Sunday Times, outlines the reporting behind their story, while journalist Michael Crick and Brendan O'Neill of Spiked discuss the political and journalistic issues. A High Court judgment has dismissed all claims brought by Prince Harry and six other claimants against Associated Newspapers over allegations that journalists used unlawful methods to obtain information. The ruling marks a significant moment in the long-running legal and political legacy of Britain's phone-hacking and press intrusion scandals. Susan Aslan, media lawyer, outlines the legal significance of the judgment.

programme.title: The Travel Show
programme.desc: The Zoological Society of London - the charity that runs London Zoo - is celebrating its 200th birthday this year. So, in an age when people are much more attuned to the welfare of animals, Roma Wells asks: what are zoos for? She sees for herself some of the pioneering innovation ZSL achieved in years gone by, some of the work it does today to rescue threatened species, and finds out what's next for animal attractions everywhere.

programme.title: Talking Business
programme.desc: Is the space economy the next gold rush? Elon Musk's SpaceX has sparked the public's imagination after its recent stock market debut, but what will all the money being thrown into the space industry actually achieve? The founder of leading investment firm Space Capital, Chad Anderson, explains how what happens in orbit is increasingly important to the economy down on Earth. Ben Thompson also hears from the head of the UN's Office for Outer Space Affairs, Aarti Holla-Maini, about how space law is keeping up with an industry that is moving at breakneck speed. Also on the programme, the billionaire founder of New Zealand-based Rocket Lab, Sir Peter Beck, shines a light on what the private sector can achieve in space and whether SpaceX are friends or rivals.

programme.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
programme.desc: The team help the people trying to save Britain’s oldest wooden ship, a football cap brings back treasured memories, and Lucia sees a complicated wooden puzzle at the V&A Museum.

programme.title: Interior Design Masters with Alan Carr
programme.desc: Alan Carr kicks off the competition by tasking ten interior designers to show off their signature styles by transforming a beach hut on the Dorset coast. They must also demonstrate their ability to reuse and repurpose where they can. Michelle Ogundehin and guest judge Jonathan Adler must decide who has created the Stand Out Space and which designer will be the first to go home.

programme.title: The Secret Letters of Mary Queen of Scots
programme.desc: Documentary tracing the extraordinary story of amateur codebreakers Satoshi Tomokiyo, George Lasry and Norbert Biermann, who collaborated across continents to decipher a mysterious cache of coded letters which were discovered to be from Mary, Queen of Scots. With whispers of spies and a treacherous son, the unlocked codes bring new insights into Mary’s long years of captivity in Elizabethan England, her power plays, complaints and clandestine methods for communicating with her followers. Set against Mary’s dramatic journey from infant queen, through civil war, to abdication and years of captivity, this film examines the lengths Mary went to conceal her words, and the ingenuity needed to decode her letters today, even with the help of 21st-century computing.

programme.title: Since Yesterday: The Untold Story of Scotland's Girl Bands
programme.desc: A feature-length documentary unearthing Scotland’s trailblazing girl bands, from 1960 onwards, that are missing from the ranks of global success. These artists were, and continue to be, ignored by the selective bias of a male-dominated industry. Featuring personal anecdotes from a host of bands, including Jeanette Gallacher from The McKinleys - the first Scottish girl band to break into the charts in 1964 and the first to play Wembley Arena. Plus The Ettes, Strawberry Switchblade, The Hedrons, Sophisticated Boom Boom, Sunset Gun, His Latest Flame, The Twinsets, Lung Leg and Hello Skinny. The film takes us on a decade-by-decade adventure, crafting the ultimate visual mixtape. Discover unheard demos, lost archives and rare performances that celebrate the women who never compromised, and subsequently got lost in time. The film takes a critical look at the barriers women have faced making music in the past, and still face today. It asks how we can inspire young women to make music, if those who do so are continuously erased from our cultural history. Written and narrated by award-nominated musician Carla J Easton, this is a powerful, global story told through a local lens.

Madcap comedy from BBC Films based on the TV series.

programme.title: Back to Life
programme.desc: When Miri Matteson returns home after eighteen years, can she integrate back into her old life? With a terrible event from her past hanging over her, it won’t be easy.

programme.title: Back to Life
programme.desc: After the awkward end to their not-a-date date, Miri offers to help Billy sort through Anna’s things. Although picking through the personal belongings of your crush’s dead wife might seem awful to most, Miri takes it in her stride - until she makes a very personal discovery. Things get worse for Miri when Janice tells her that she needs a bank account before she can start working at the supermarket. Miri does have a bank account but hasn’t used it since 2001. Unfortunately, the branded piggy banks she was given all those years ago are no longer relevant, and once again Miri must navigate a world she barely recognises.

programme.title: Back to Life
programme.desc: The morning after she was knocked off her bike by a mysterious car, Miri is convinced that John Boback was the one who drove into her, but her parents are not sure. When Oscar lets slip that the Bobacks are organising a vigil for Lara, Miri takes this as more proof that John is trying to ensure the town never forgets what Miri has done. Caroline is also preoccupied with Lara’s vigil, and with Oscar focused on Make Hythe Clean, she decides to return to the Ladies of Hythe. This time she brings biscuits. In a bid to put the vigil out of her mind, Miri hitches a ride along with Billy for the day, but is shocked when they arrive at his mother’s birthday party. After a failed attempt at hiding, Miri has no choice but to meet Gaia, who miraculously seems to be a fan. At the party, Miri bumps into someone from her past who reminds her that she doesn’t need to pretend to be something she’s not.

programme.desc: Captured by Vikings, the Doctor and Clara must help protect their village from space warriors from the future, the Mire. Outnumbered and outgunned, their fate seems inevitable. So why is the Doctor preoccupied with a single Viking girl?

programme.title: Doctor Who (2005–2022)
programme.desc: England, 1651. Deadly highwayman 'the Knightmare' and his sidekick stalk the dark streets of London. But when they find loot that is not of this world, they come face to face with the Doctor. Who is the Knightmare in league with? And can the Doctor avoid the hangman's noose and protect the Earth from a devilish betrayal?

programme.title: Not Going Out
programme.desc: Lee makes no effort to talk to other parents in the playground, and Lucy is worried that he is becoming isolated and friendless. She fires him up to go into school and make some new friends. Reluctantly Lee gives it a try. He opens up with strangers and makes friends with another lone male, Keith. But Keith is even less sociable than Lee.

programme.title: Not Going Out
programme.desc: Confined to a wheelchair, his right leg encased in plaster after knee surgery, Lee has too much time on his hands, which he uses to watch the world go by through a pair of high-powered binoculars. He soon realises that all is not well in his neighbour’s house opposite. In fact, he is quickly convinced that something despicable is going on.

programme.title: Schitt's Creek
programme.desc: Moira’s younger sister Deedee makes a surprise visit, and the two pick up where they left off: jealous and resentful of each other. David is pressed to step out of his comfort zone by trying to help one of Jocelyn’s students who is having a hard time fitting in. Meanwhile, Alexis meddles in Mutt’s relationship with Twyla from the cafe by giving her some unsolicited advice. When Twyla takes it to heart, she decides to break up with Mutt, leaving Alexis to suffer the fallout.

programme.title: Schitt's Creek
programme.desc: It’s Moira’s birthday, and Johnny plans on getting the entire family to help throw a surprise party. But the cover story of a charity fundraiser draws Moira to get involved in the planning. David must keep his fussy mother from taking complete control and insulting the locals who volunteered to put the event together. Alexis and Johnny have some father-daughter time when they visit Elmdale to pick up the birthday cake.

programme.title: Schitt's Creek
programme.desc: Johnny has finally found a way out of Schitt’s Creek, and his name is Andy, a businessman who plans on buying the town. All that Johnny needs now is Andy’s signature, but Roland hits it off with the guy, delaying the signing. Meanwhile, Alexis, knowing she is escaping, finds things complicated by Ted proposing and her finally revealing her true feelings to Mutt. David, feeling abandoned by his family and best friend Stevie, leaves town in Roland's pick-up.

programme.title: Mrs Brown's Boys
programme.desc: All over Dublin, mothers are excitedly looking forward to seeing their loved ones return home for Christmas. But Agnes Brown is depressed. Her son Trevor is on the missions in Canada and can't possibly afford to make it back. With Maria's posh mum Hillary pressing the newlyweds to spend Christmas at her place, Agnes decides to compete for their love by providing an even more lavish Christmas celebration than Hillary's - even if Buster is having trouble delivering the turkey.

programme.title: Mrs Brown's Boys
programme.desc: After faking Grandad's death, the Brown family are still waiting for the insurance money to come through. Agnes has promised the money to Dermot and Maria, who are desperate for a place of their own, but the insurance company is starting to get suspicious. Will Agnes be able to keep Grandad out of sight, or will one of the family give the game away?

programme.title: Only Child

programme.title: Only Child

David, feeling abandoned by his family and best friend Stevie, leaves town in Roland's pick-up.

programme.title: Mrs Brown's Boys
programme.desc: All over Dublin, mothers are excitedly looking forward to seeing their loved ones return home for Christmas. But Agnes Brown is depressed. Her son Trevor is on the missions in Canada and can't possibly afford to make it back. With Maria's posh mum Hillary pressing the newlyweds to spend Christmas at her place, Agnes decides to compete for their love by providing an even more lavish Christmas celebration than Hillary's - even if Buster is having trouble delivering the turkey.

programme.title: Mrs Brown's Boys
programme.desc: After faking Grandad's death, the Brown family are still waiting for the insurance money to come through. Agnes has promised the money to Dermot and Maria, who are desperate for a place of their own, but the insurance company is starting to get suspicious. Will Agnes be able to keep Grandad out of sight, or will one of the family give the game away?

programme.title: Only Child
programme.desc: After his dream Norway job doesn’t go quite to plan, Richard just wants to hide away from the world. Sadly for him, Ken has other ideas - mainly forcing him to join the protest group fighting to save the local allotments.

programme.title: Only Child
programme.desc: A depressed Richard searches for a real job and embarks on a fitness journey as his 40th birthday looms. Meanwhile, Ken prepares for his first first date in almost 60 years.

programme.title: Only Child
programme.desc: Ken needs to resit his driving exam in order to win back his licence. Richard offers to take him out on a mock test, not realising just how rusty his dad has become behind the wheel.

programme.title: Lost and Found in the Lakes
programme.desc: The scubas are out and about, determined to try to help Stephen put right a wrong when he lost his dad’s prized possession 36 years ago, while on the same lake the freedivers attempt to rescue Richard’s wedding ring, which he lost only a week before. Crafter Dave transforms a rusty old anchor beyond recognition.

programme.title: Natalie Cassidy: Caring Together
programme.desc: Natalie speaks to a friend about caring for a child with cancer before joining community nursing in action - and faces her own fear, needles!

programme.title: This is BBC Two
programme.desc: Highlights of programmes on BBC Two.

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: When Nugget’s favourite teddy bear gets accidentally washed by Pancake, the Piripenguins try to restore its unique smell by painstakingly recreating Nugget’s happiest memories.

programme.title: Big Lizard
programme.desc: Ammon gets spooked by a tiny insect, but overcomes her fear to rescue Cosima and Big Lizard from the rapids.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: Weasy smashes a hole in the grain store with his boomerang. The farmer thinks his cow is to blame and decides to sell it. The ducklings can't believe Weasy would allow the cow to take the blame - they need to sort this out!

programme.title: Super Happy Magic Forest
programme.desc: Mr Friendlyface’s hat has been stolen by a Big Ole Worm, and the heroes must quest to get it back. As they trail the worm through the Prickly Desert, Trevor accidentally spikes himself all over on a cactus. But all is not lost – now that he is covered in sharp spikes, Trevor realises that he has a unique superpower, and when the time comes to confront the Big Ole Worm, it’s Spiky Trevor to the rescue!

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings are throwing a big birthday party, but Grizzy is not in the mood.

programme.title: Duck and Frog
programme.desc: Duck is in charge of a campsite and has to make sure everyone follows the rules. However, Frog turns up and breaks them all - he lets goats loose and has a midnight party in his tent.

programme.title: Pokémon Horizons
programme.desc: Roy and his Pokémon face Nemona in a match-up of powerful battling styles!

programme.title: Winx Club - The Magic Is Back
programme.desc: When Stella’s ring mysteriously disappears, the Winx embark on a risky mission to retrieve it from Cloud Tower. As they explore the school’s eerie tunnels, Bloom faces a powerful awakening.

programme.title: The Next Step: Cheer
programme.desc: When a legendary coach abruptly leaves a highly successful cheerleading gym, the team are left in disarray, The Next Step’s Kenzie steps in to take over what’s left of the team, desperate to prove she is more than just a dancer, and that she can build this rag-tag group of athletes into a contender for nationals.

programme.title: Blue Peter
programme.desc: Shini meets one of the biggest pop stars on the planet, Harry Styles, during his record-breaking run of shows at Wembley Stadium! Plus, we go behind the scenes at Wimbledon to try all the jobs that keep the tournament on track.

programme.title: Newsround
programme.desc: Topical news magazine for children.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Gardeners’ World comes from the very first RHS Badminton Flower Show, set in the beautiful south Gloucestershire countryside. Adam Frost, Rachel De Thame and Ashley Edwards explore the show gardens, young designer gardens, feature gardens, pocket planting and artisan gardens, and seek out the season's must-have plants in the floral marquee. There are also oodles of practical gardening advice and innovative design to inspire you in your garden.

programme.title: This Wild Life
programme.desc: Wildlife expert Saba Douglas-Hamilton, together with her husband Frank and their three young children, move to the romantic Samburu National Reserve in Kenya to run a safari camp for the first time. But life out there isn't easy. There are monkeys in the kitchen, floods threatening the camp, and with no fences to keep out the wildlife, elephants are regular house guests. This series follows their ups and downs as the family struggles to keep guests, elephants, lions and even crocodiles smiling. Things get off to a rocky start when guests arrive earlier than expected and an elephant emergency pushes everyone to their limits. Has the family got what it takes to survive their new wild life?

programme.title: Talking Tennis
programme.desc: Tennis addict Alistair McGowan serves up another affectionate look back at one of the world's greatest tournaments - Wimbledon. Here he looks at the champions who, over the years, transformed the game, setting new levels of excellence and in some cases shocking us all with their antics. With classic interviews and rarely seen footage from the BBC's archives, this episode features Billie Jean King and Arthur Ashe breaking down barriers, Becker and Borg representing youth and (male) beauty, Cash and Agassi and the game's fashion changers, Henman and Murray changing Britain's expectations of success and the most changeable feature of any Wimbledon fortnight - the weather.

programme.title: Wimbledon
programme.desc: Live coverage of the Championships at the All England Lawn Tennis Club at Wimbledon.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Anita Manning is in charge of today’s Bargain Hunt, which comes from Ballinderry in Northern Ireland. The experts are Ben Cooper and Charles Hanson, who will be helping today’s teams spend £300 on three items that could make them a profit at auction. Anita also pays a visit to one of Belfast’s well-known water holes, the Crown Bar.

programme.title: North by Northwest
programme.desc: Classic Alfred Hitchcock thriller. When advertising executive Roger Thornhill is mistaken for the mysterious Mr Kaplan by a ruthless espionage ring, he soon faces deadly peril, framed for murder. On the run, Thornhill seeks Kaplan, the one person who can verify his story.

programme.title: Vertigo
programme.desc: Suddenly dangerously disorientated by heights, detective John Ferguson resigns from the San Francisco police and is reluctant when asked by an old college friend to trail the man's wife, Madeleine, whose behaviour is causing concern. But John gradually becomes obsessed with the troubled woman and increasingly intervenes in her life. Classic Hitchcock psychological thriller.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Paul Martin presents from Wrest Park, a Georgian manor house surrounded by 18th-century formal gardens in the Bedfordshire countryside. Antiques experts Anita Manning and Christina Trevanion select the best antiques and collectibles to take to auction. Paul also takes a stroll down the high street of Amersham to explore the market town's unusual and varied history.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Margie Cooper and Ishy Khan are joined by former titans of the 90s Gladiators ring, Diane ‘Jet’ Youdale and James ‘Hunter’ Crossley. They swap pugil sticks for haggling in and around the shops of Lancashire in their tiny classic Fiat 500 car, teaming up with experts Ishy Khan and Margie Cooper. In Eccleston, Diane uncovers a unique sculptural piece, while in Longridge, James bags a buy that reminds him of his beloved dog. In Darwen, there’s a sporty stop off in store as our foursome learn about a legendary local strongman, and the Gladiators show off some of their own strength. But who will be successful on the auction travellator?

programme.title: Dad's Army
programme.desc: Classic wartime sitcom. Captain Mainwaring and his platoon are instructed to guard a captive U-boat crew. Are they up to the job?

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: The Top of the Pops archives are opened once again as the show moves into the 21st century. Kylie gets us spinning, whilst The Corrs leave us Breathless in a year that saw the return of legends such as Bon Jovi and U2. Dance music and hip-hop were regulars in the chart too, with hits from Destiny’s Child, Sonique and Eminem. Plus a generous sprinkling of good shiny pop. Featuring Kylie, Ronan Keating, The Corrs, Blink-182, Spiller, Baha Men, Destiny’s Child, Eminem, Bon Jovi, Sonique, Robbie Williams, Britney Spears, Craig David, All Saints, Black Legend, Joey Negro and Taka Boom, S Club and U2.

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: Top of the Pops officially enters the new millennium. In a year that saw the highest number of individual number ones, dance music is on the rise (again) thanks to the boom in filesharing, helping DJs such as Sonique and Spiller top the charts. Craig David takes a seemingly permanent residence in the Top 10, whilst pop continues to dominate not just the chart but TV sets too, with S Club back for their second album and second TV series. American hip-hop is on the rise, whilst the show still has room for more eclectic bands such as Eels. Contributors include Craig David, Sonique, S Club, Spiller, Darude, Scott Robinson from 5ive, Eels’ Mark 'E' Everett and broadcasters Trevor Nelson, Pete Tong and Sarah Cawood.

programme.title: Radio 2 In Concert
programme.desc: Southampton-born R&B and garage king Craig David performs an intimate show in the BBC’s Radio Theatre in central London for Radio 2. He and his band perform tracks from his recent, seventh album The Time Is Now as well as classics from his best-selling debut Born To Do It, which was released in 2000 and spawned classics like Fill Me In and 7 Days.

programme.title: Wimbledon
programme.desc: A look back at the day’s play at Wimbledon.

programme.title: Golf: Scottish Open
programme.desc: Highlights from Saturday’s play as a stacked field featuring the world’s best players compete for the Genesis Scottish Open at The Renaissance Club in East Lothian. Masters Champion Rory McIlroy and World Number One Scottie Scheffler headline a stellar start list for the event which takes place a week before the 154th Open Championship. American Chris Gotterup is in great form as he looks to defend the title he won in 2025, with the home challengers including PGA Champion and 2020 Scottish Open winner Aaron Rai, 2024 winner Bob McIntyre, along with Tommy Fleetwood, Tyrrell Hatton, Marco Penge and the Fitzpatrick brothers.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: From the sublime to the ridiculous - a painting by an Australian war artist, a silver claret jug and two diamond rings contrast with a painting with a large hole through the middle and a permit for carrying a cigarette lighter in Portugal. Michael and the experts visit Leeds Town Hall.

programme.title: Oul Treasures
programme.desc: Presenter Lolly Spence tracks down family heirlooms and prized possessions from Ulster’s bygone days in desperate need of repair. In each episode, a unique object is returned to its former glory by local experts, as Lolly explores its historic and cultural connections to the Ulster-Scots story. Along the way, she meets some of Northern Ireland’s finest restorers, the men and women helping keep our traditional crafts alive. The first object up for repair is one that’s very close to home for Lolly – a battered old bible that’s been in her family since the 1800s. But after sitting in an attic for decades, can it be returned to its former glory?

programme.title: GAA Live
programme.desc: Sarah Mulkerrins presents full match coverage of the opening semi-final in the GAA All-Ireland Senior Football Championship at Croke Park. With a coveted spot in the All-Ireland final up for grabs, the pressure intensifies at this crucial stage of the Championship.

programme.title: Barra on the Foyle
programme.desc: Barra Best makes a journey across the 4,000 square kilometres of the Foyle network, criss-crossing the many rivers and streams that make up its great catchment. Along the way, he meets with some of those who work, live and play along its banks, exploring places and landscapes rarely seen on our television screens, and all brought to life with some stunning aerial footage.

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: When Nugget’s favourite teddy bear gets accidentally washed by Pancake, the Piripenguins try to restore its unique smell by painstakingly recreating Nugget’s happiest memories.

programme.title: Big Lizard
programme.desc: Ammon gets spooked by a tiny insect, but overcomes her fear to rescue Cosima and Big Lizard from the rapids.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: Weasy smashes a hole in the grain store with his boomerang. The farmer thinks his cow is to blame and decides to sell it. The ducklings can't believe Weasy would allow the cow to take the blame - they need to sort this out!

programme.title: Super Happy Magic Forest
programme.desc: Mr Friendlyface’s hat has been stolen by a Big Ole Worm, and the heroes must quest to get it back. As they trail the worm through the Prickly Desert, Trevor accidentally spikes himself all over on a cactus. programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings are throwing a big birthday party, but Grizzy is not in the mood.

programme.title: Duck and Frog
programme.desc: Duck is in charge of a campsite and has to make sure everyone follows the rules. However, Frog turns up and breaks them all - he lets goats loose and has a midnight party in his tent.

programme.title: Pokémon Horizons
programme.desc: Roy and his Pokémon face Nemona in a match-up of powerful battling styles!

programme.title: Winx Club - The Magic Is Back
programme.desc: When Stella’s ring mysteriously disappears, the Winx embark on a risky mission to retrieve it from Cloud Tower. As they explore the school’s eerie tunnels, Bloom faces a powerful awakening.

programme.title: The Next Step: Cheer
programme.desc: When a legendary coach abruptly leaves a highly successful cheerleading gym, the team are left in disarray, The Next Step’s Kenzie steps in to take over what’s left of the team, desperate to prove she is more than just a dancer, and that she can build this rag-tag group of athletes into a contender for nationals.

programme.title: Blue Peter
programme.desc: Shini meets one of the biggest pop stars on the planet, Harry Styles, during his record-breaking run of shows at Wembley Stadium! Plus, we go behind the scenes at Wimbledon to try all the jobs that keep the tournament on track.

programme.title: Newsround
programme.desc: Topical news magazine for children.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Gardeners’ World comes from the very first RHS Badminton Flower Show, set in the beautiful south Gloucestershire countryside. Adam Frost, Rachel De Thame and Ashley Edwards explore the show gardens, young designer gardens, feature gardens, pocket planting and artisan gardens, and seek out the season's must-have plants in the floral marquee. There are also oodles of practical gardening advice and innovative design to inspire you in your garden.

programme.title: This Wild Life
programme.desc: Wildlife expert Saba Douglas-Hamilton, together with her husband Frank and their three young children, move to the romantic Samburu National Reserve in Kenya to run a safari camp for the first time. But life out there isn't easy. There are monkeys in the kitchen, floods threatening the camp, and with no fences to keep out the wildlife, elephants are regular house guests. This series follows their ups and downs as the family struggles to keep guests, elephants, lions and even crocodiles smiling. Things get off to a rocky start when guests arrive earlier than expected and an elephant emergency pushes everyone to their limits. Has the family got what it takes to survive their new wild life?

programme.title: Talking Tennis
programme.desc: Tennis addict Alistair McGowan serves up another affectionate look back at one of the world's greatest tournaments - Wimbledon. Here he looks at the champions who, over the years, transformed the game, setting new levels of excellence and in some cases shocking us all with their antics. With classic interviews and rarely seen footage from the BBC's archives, this episode features Billie Jean King and Arthur Ashe breaking down barriers, Becker and Borg representing youth and (male) beauty, Cash and Agassi and the game's fashion changers, Henman and Murray changing Britain's expectations of success and the most changeable feature of any Wimbledon fortnight - the weather.

programme.title: Wimbledon
programme.desc: Live coverage of the Championships at the All England Lawn Tennis Club at Wimbledon.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Anita Manning is in charge of today’s Bargain Hunt, which comes from Ballinderry in Northern Ireland. The experts are Ben Cooper and Charles Hanson, who will be helping today’s teams spend £300 on three items that could make them a profit at auction. Anita also pays a visit to one of Belfast’s well-known water holes, the Crown Bar.

programme.title: North by Northwest
programme.desc: Classic Alfred Hitchcock thriller. When advertising executive Roger Thornhill is mistaken for the mysterious Mr Kaplan by a ruthless espionage ring, he soon faces deadly peril, framed for murder. On the run, Thornhill seeks Kaplan, the one person who can verify his story.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: From the sublime to the ridiculous - a painting by an Australian war artist, a silver claret jug and two diamond rings contrast with a painting with a large hole through the middle and a permit for carrying a cigarette lighter in Portugal. Michael and the experts visit Leeds Town Hall.

programme.title: Oul Treasures
programme.desc: Presenter Lolly Spence tracks down family heirlooms and prized possessions from Ulster’s bygone days in desperate need of repair. In each episode, a unique object is returned to its former glory by local experts, as Lolly explores its historic and cultural connections to the Ulster-Scots story. Along the way, she meets some of Northern Ireland’s finest restorers, the men and women helping keep our traditional crafts alive. The first object up for repair is one that’s very close to home for Lolly – a battered old bible that’s been in her family since the 1800s. But after sitting in an attic for decades, can it be returned to its former glory?

programme.title: GAA Live
programme.desc: Sarah Mulkerrins presents full match coverage of the opening semi-final in the GAA All-Ireland Senior Football Championship at Croke Park. With a coveted spot in the All-Ireland final up for grabs, the pressure intensifies at this crucial stage of the Championship.

programme.title: Barra on the Foyle
programme.desc: Barra Best makes a journey across the 4,000 square kilometres of the Foyle network, criss-crossing the many rivers and streams that make up its great catchment. Along the way, he meets with some of those who work, live and play along its banks, exploring places and landscapes rarely seen on our television screens, and all brought to life with some stunning aerial footage.

programme.title: Dad's Army
programme.desc: Classic wartime sitcom. Captain Mainwaring and his platoon are instructed to guard a captive U-boat crew. Are they up to the job?

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: The Top of the Pops archives are opened once again as the show moves into the 21st century. Kylie gets us spinning, whilst The Corrs leave us Breathless in a year that saw the return of legends such as Bon Jovi and U2. Dance music and hip-hop were regulars in the chart too, with hits from Destiny’s Child, Sonique and Eminem. Plus a generous sprinkling of good shiny pop. Featuring Kylie, Ronan Keating, The Corrs, Blink-182, Spiller, Baha Men, Destiny’s Child, Eminem, Bon Jovi, Sonique, Robbie Williams, Britney Spears, Craig David, All Saints, Black Legend, Joey Negro and Taka Boom, S Club and U2.

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: Top of the Pops officially enters the new millennium. In a year that saw the highest number of individual number ones, dance music is on the rise (again) thanks to the boom in filesharing, helping DJs such as Sonique and Spiller top the charts. Craig David takes a seemingly permanent residence in the Top 10, whilst pop continues to dominate not just the chart but TV sets too, with S Club back for their second album and second TV series. American hip-hop is on the rise, whilst the show still has room for more eclectic bands such as Eels. Contributors include Craig David, Sonique, S Club, Spiller, Darude, Scott Robinson from 5ive, Eels’ Mark 'E' Everett and broadcasters Trevor Nelson, Pete Tong and Sarah Cawood.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Margie Cooper and Ishy Khan are joined by former titans of the 90s Gladiators ring, Diane ‘Jet’ Youdale and James ‘Hunter’ Crossley. In Eccleston, Diane uncovers a unique sculptural piece, while in Longridge, James bags a buy that reminds him of his beloved dog. In Darwen, there’s a sporty stop off in store as our foursome learn about a legendary local strongman, and the Gladiators show off some of their own strength. But who will be successful on the auction travellator?

programme.title: Roots and Fruits

When Robotato continues to glitch, he becomes overly protective of Evil Pea and takes her to the top of Tato Tower to keep her safe. programme.title: Bing

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Pando is teaching Bing and Sula how to do little kicks and big kicks with a ball in the garden. Sula does the biggest kick of them all, but Bing kicks the ball the wrong way. programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: It is Tag's birthday and Duggee has put up a bouncy castle to celebrate. It's a lovely sunny day, and the squirrels are all excited. They are just about to get bouncing when a big, gloomy cloud settles down and falls asleep right over the bouncy castle. How can they wake it up? Well, they could bounce up and tell it to move. Is this something Hedgley the hedgehog can help them with?

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels go for a woodland walk to help Duggee look for a very special leaf when they hear the strangest noise. In the distance, they can see a funny shape. What is that noise? What is that shape? Maybe it's a monster? No, wait! It's only Hedgley the hedgehog, who has been trundling around the forest collecting all sorts of leaves and twigs on his spiky quills, which make him look and sound like a leafy monster.

programme.title: Bluey

With the help of some friendly astronauts, Glitch and Ubercorn try to get a message to the Go Jetters before Grim HQ sinks to the bottom of the sea...

When Dashi is accidentally swallowed by a whale shark, the Octonauts venture inside the huge fish to rescue her.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: It’s secret agent time when Mojo and Bo think Didi the tractor is up to something fishy. But can the two supersecret spies follow her without being spotted?

programme.title: Football Fantastics

programme.title: Something Special

programme.title: Bluey

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey teaches Bingo how to use magic so she can make Mum play with her.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels are admiring everything Duggee has grown in his vegetable garden, especially his crop of giant carrots, when they hear a noise. They investigate and find the Rabbits busy preparing for the Carrot Solstice, the day when the sun is at its highest. On this day, they gather round Carrot Henge to celebrate the glory of this humble vegetable. Trouble is, the Rabbits need to go and get ready – but who will look after the carrots? The Squirrels volunteer, so off the Rabbits go. Looking after the carrots seems easy at first, and Norrie arranges tasks for everyone. Betty skillfully organises the queue while Roly is on toilet duty. And then, disaster strikes. Worm pops up and eats part of Carrot Henge. Duggee is dispatched to fetch one of his own giant carrots to fill the gap. As time ticks on with no Duggee in sight, the place gets busier, and the sun is nearly at the top. Will Duggee fix the Henge in time, or will Carrot Solstice be ruined?

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels are looking for Duggee but can’t find him. Instead, they find someone they think is Enid, only much too big... Duggee has painted his face to look like Enid! Of course, the Squirrels want their faces painted too, so Duggee sets to it.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: The fearsome Great Gnanna Gnome has a case of bottom-fungal-itis. Zog and the doctors must figure out how to treat the mushroom without incurring Gnanna's anger.

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: Brinicle tries to turn the Krispy Krill shack into a top restaurant to impress a secret reviewer, but chef Pancake’s cooking proves unpopular, and Looph’s plate machine misfires.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: Rafi is busy making a half birthday card for baby Oscar, but with ukulele practice, library reading and Teacup the dog to play with, she has a lot to do. She wishes for more versions of herself, and four colourful Rafis appear. Chaos ensues, until Dash encourages Rafi to take charge. She gets each Rafi to focus on one job - crafts, reading, music and play. At the café, the Rafis sing for Oscar, present the card, and then merge back into one.

programme.title: Big Lizard
programme.desc: Whilst exploring deep space, a meteor strikes Cosima and Dad's ship! After crash-landing on the unexplored planet of Proxima, Cosima makes a new best friend called Big Lizard.

programme.title: Spidey and His Amazing Friends
programme.desc: Spidey meets Moon Girl. Hulk becomes a squirrel.

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: A baby elephant separated from its herd needs the Octonauts' help swimming to safety.

programme.title: Knee High Spies
programme.desc: The spies save Scarlett's homework from dog Mazey as Deena learns to bond with the pet.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: It’s Weasy’s birthday! He is keen to find out if the ducklings got him his dream present, but he keeps ruining their party preparations. The ducklings immobilise Weasy, which gives the Chipmunk an opportunity to steal his presents.

programme.title: Talking Tom Heroes: Suddenly Super
programme.desc: Tom wants the team to come up with a perfect signature move.

programme.title: Monster Makes
programme.desc: Rebecca and Murphi are trying to come up with a new move to perfect their competition dance routine. They take a break for an ice-cold monster shake and find time to create a bottle penguin. The Mini Monsters demonstrate how to make everlasting sandcastles, and Rebecca’s aunt calls from space - where she has made some alien friends. The Recycling Express arrives with empty tissue boxes, inspiring a mega monster make – a funny pineapple puppet.

programme.title: My World Kitchen
programme.desc: Connor lives in Scotland. He makes a delicious vegetarian haggis, to share with his friends. He serves his tasty haggis with freshly mashed neeps and tatties. As an extra special surprise, Connor has arranged for a special guest to play the Scottish bagpipes as the haggis is served, and his friends have no idea about this special surprise! They are all looking forward to trying the food, but they were not very keen on fresh coriander, which is one of the ingredients. Connor hopes to change their minds when they taste his vegetarian haggis.

programme.title: Hamza Loves Animals: Africa

JB finds out about a green vegetable that’s ready to harvest in spring and he meets some children in London who are making fresh food to eat at their local farm. Storm shares a colourful spring poem and we go to a bakery to see something tasty being made with flour – pizza!

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels are digging in the garden when they come across a fossil, so Duggee and Narrator explain all about fossils and prehistoric times. When the Squirrels go outside, it seems like they've gone right back in time.

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: The Octonauts roam the oceans in search of adventure and fun. The Octonauts are exploring Antarctica when Shellington discovers strange microscopic creatures living under the ice.

programme.desc: When Popcorn accidentally breaks the x-ray machine, he does everything he can to fix it before Vida finds out, but all he needs to do is ask for help. When he finally does, Vida knows just what to do and assures Popcorn he’s still the best vet tech ever.

Lars makes friends with a baby lemur whose family has been scared away by a bright light and loud banging in the distance. The team investigates and discovers the cause: Grandmaster Glitch is illuminating Grim HQ with floodlights, while his Grimbots try to dislodge it from the tree.

programme.desc: Kika is a golden labrador and guide dog for her owner Dr Amit, who is blind, which means he cannot see. Dr Amit is helping Raj the grocer judge the carrots in the fruit and veg competition at the Woofton country fair. Kika is helping Dr Amit, including with the mouthwatering task of finding the tastiest carrot in Woofton! But when Amit has to bring the prize-winning carrots to the photographer from the Woofton Gazette, Kika must guide Amit safely back through the maze of stalls, visitors and obstacles while carrying a precious carrot cargo.
